g.text: An empty approver set admits any ledger-authorized
actor. Each actor decides at most once and every
decisionId is globally unique. The approval deadline
(from the node timeout policy) is recorded, published
as the run's due_at, and enforced: at expiry the
recovery scheduler self-signs timerFired and the wait
resumes with disposition timedOut. Publish validation
requires a timedOut route wherever a timeout is
A timer whose deadline expression cannot be
computed never parks: the token routes failed
the error value root. Literal deadlines are
rejected at publish time unless they parse
